title: Kissed Tender Ethiopian Chicken Bake
description: A savory and tender Ethiopian dish featuring yellow curry paste, perfect for a low-carb dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the yellow curry paste, coconut oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the bowl and mix well.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the curry paste mixture.
Transfer the chicken mixture to a baking dish and pour in the chicken broth.
Bake the chicken in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
